name: Antelope bitterbrush
desc: Antelope bitterbrush (Purshia tridentata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 161 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Purshia tridentata, with the common name bitterbrush, is a shrub in the genus Purshia of the family Rosaceae. It is native to mountainous areas of western North America.
